newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia releases revised labour statistics.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia releases revised labour statistics.

text.p: Australian employment and unemployment statistics have been revised by the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) following the annual reanalysis of seasonal adjustment factors.
The revisions lowered the January 1997 employment estimate to 8,425,100 from the originally published 8,439,900. The unemployment rate was unchanged at 8.6 percent.

"The reanalysis of seasonal factors incorporates the most recent 12 months of labour force data, to produce revised seasonal factors," the ABS said in a statement, adding revisions may occur to estimates for 1996 and previous years.

The revisions are not releated to the implementation of a new telephone survey method from last August, which the ABS has said was producing monthly employment estimates 6,000 to 9,000 lower than the previous face-to-face interview method.

"No, it's just the standard seasonal reanalysis that we conduct every year," an ABS spokeswoman said, when asked if the revisions had taken into account the lower employment estimates from the new survey method.
Any such revisions would be a seperate process, the spokeswoman said.
